name: LP removal percent that trips signal 1
comparison: lpRemovedPct > lpRemovalPct (strict). V2: lpRemovedPct = (10000 - currentSupply*10000/baselineSupply)/100 against the LP totalSupply at buy time; V3: the same on pool.liquidity() (active liquidity at the current tick)
units: percent of the LP baseline taken at buy time
representation: Number() of the env string; the measured value is integer basis points (bigint) divided by 100, so steps of 0.01 %
effective_empty: 0 (?? keeps the empty string, Number("") is 0 and passes the 0..100 check): any LP decrease trips signal 1
rationale: none in code beyond the config.ts:84 description
overlap: AND-ed with signals 2 and 3 (TH-ANTIRUG-11, TH-ANTIRUG-12); on V3 signals 2 and 3 are effectively always tripped (AUD-ANTIRUG-006), so this is the only working V3 gate
recommendation: Treat an empty value as unset, reject 0, and document why 50 % (card ANTIRUG-07; V3 semantics card ANTIRUG-03).

name: Confirm-after-N-blocks delay before an anti-rug exit
comparison: confirmBlocks === 0 dispatches at once; otherwise the gate fires at the first polled block >= getBlockNumber()-at-scheduling + confirmBlocks and re-reads live state
units: blocks, counted from when the log is processed, not from the log block
representation: Number() with an integer and >= 0 check
effective_empty: 0 (no confirmation, synchronous dispatch inside the evaluator and inside a backfill)
rationale: config.ts:85: higher values for reorg-volatile chains
overlap: the ethers block poll (4 s, subscriber-polling.js:45) adds up to one poll of delay; with 0 the exit runs inside backfill and registration (AUD-ANTIRUG-005)
recommendation: Treat empty as unset; count from the log block; state the intended delay in seconds per chain, since 1 block is 12 s on ETH and about 0.25 s on Arbitrum (cards ANTIRUG-07, ANTIRUG-01).

name: Circuit-breaker trip count
comparison: recent.length >= threshold trips (once per trip); the ring buffer keeps the last threshold events
units: triggerAntiRugExit calls per chain within the window (each log dispatch counts, refusals included), not rugs or positions
representation: Number() with an integer and >= 1 check
rationale: exitTrigger.ts:32-35: defence against rapid-fire false positives
overlap: multiplied by duplicate dispatch sources (AUD-ANTIRUG-001, -005, -007); the increment comes after the exit, so the threshold-th exit is already sent
recommendation: Count per position or rug event, not per log (card ANTIRUG-01), and persist the trip (card ANTIRUG-04).

name: Circuit-breaker rolling window
comparison: a trigger counts while now - t < windowHours * 3600 * 1000
units: hours (integer); milliseconds internally; wall clock of the running process
representation: Number() with an integer and >= 1 check
effective_non_numeric: fatal exit at boot (a fraction such as 0.5 is also rejected)
rationale: none in code
overlap: history and trip are lost on restart (AUD-ANTIRUG-010)
recommendation: Persist the history and trip state (card ANTIRUG-04); allow minutes if a shorter window is wanted.

name: Anti-rug gas multiplier on the emergency sell
comparison: multiplies the fee fields of the private anti-rug sell only (passed to submitPrivateSell; applyGasMultiplier in the MEV strategies)
representation: Number() float, >= 1.0, no upper bound; applied to bigint fees through applyGasMultiplier (TX slice)
rationale: chainRegistry.ts:848-861 comment: higher urgency of front-running a rug pull
overlap: same number as TH-EXIT-20 (EXIT inventory); the sell-leg priority-fee ceiling is TH-EXIT-23
recommendation: Add an upper bound and fail loud above it (card ANTIRUG-07); confirm the TX-slice multiplication is exact bigint math.

name: Backfill getLogs block range per call
comparison: chunks of cap blocks: chunkEnd = min(chunkStart + cap - 1, toBlock), one getLogs per chunk, serial
representation: Number() with an integer check in [1, 100000]
rationale: ETH 10: Alchemy free-tier cap (chainRegistry.ts:223-224 comment); others 500: conservative public RPC
overlap: with TH-ANTIRUG-07, ETH needs up to 720 serial calls for a full window, run inside registration (AUD-ANTIRUG-005)
recommendation: Keep the per-provider cap but run the backfill off the buy path (AUD-ANTIRUG-005, card ANTIRUG-02). The differing ETH default has a stated reason.

name: Maximum backfill window before GAP DETECTED
comparison: gapBlocks > maxBackfillBlocks skips the whole replay and advances last_seen_block; gap is measured from the last (re)subscription, not from the outage start
representation: Number() with an integer check, >= backfill cap
rationale: config.ts:90: about 1 day (true at 12 s blocks only)
overlap: about 24 h on ETH, 4 h on Base, 30 min on Arbitrum at typical block times (not in the repo); combined with last_seen_block advancing only on subscription, most reconnects skip the replay (AUD-ANTIRUG-005)
recommendation: Express the window in time per chain and measure the gap from the last seen live block (card ANTIRUG-02).

name: Anti-rug live-execute switch
current_value: false on all four chains (unset, dry-run)
comparison: strict string equality with "true"; false logs, alerts and broadcasts would-have-sold and returns before the breaker and the sell
effective_non_numeric: false for anything but exactly "true" (TRUE, 1, yes are false)
rationale: types.ts:121-123 and config.ts:83: live only after the 7-day dry run with 0 false positives
overlap: gated at boot by the 7-day floor TH-ANTIRUG-10; dry-run never exercises the breaker
recommendation: No change to the switch itself; the gate that guards it is TH-ANTIRUG-10 (OD-19, Phase 32).

name: Anti-rug locker allowlist overlays
comparison: case-insensitive equality of the log destination (V2 Burn/Transfer to, V3 Burn/Collect owner) with any entry; a hit short-circuits to allowlisted (no exit)
units: addresses (not a number; listed because a hit decides whether an emergency sell happens)
effective_non_numeric: an invalid address or checksum is a fatal exit at boot; an address with no code is a fatal exit at verify (allowlist.ts:135-148)
rationale: chainRegistry.ts:417-446 (D-V3-ALLOWLIST)
overlap: on V3 the owner field is the position manager for NFT positions, so lockers cannot match (AUD-ANTIRUG-006)
recommendation: Decide what a lock means on V3 (card ANTIRUG-03).

name: Dry-run floor before live execute is allowed
comparison: now - antirug_dry_run_started >= SEVEN_DAYS_SEC at boot when LIVE_EXECUTE is "true"; no stamp fails
units: seconds of wall clock since the first startChainAntiRugListener ever on this DB
rationale: config.ts:83 and types.ts:121-123 (7-day dry run with 0 false positives)
overlap: guards TH-ANTIRUG-08; card OD-19 is owned by Phase 32
recommendation: Measure monitored time and evaluated events, reset on detector changes (OD-19, Phase 32; AUD-ANTIRUG-009).

name: V2 signal 3: reserve floor
comparison: reserve0Pct < 50 || reserve1Pct < 50 against the reserves at buy time
rationale: detector.ts:1476-1480 header (sell-feasibility signal)
overlap: a 4x price move in either direction halves one reserve on a constant-product pool, so this trips on price movement alone; it is redundant with TH-ANTIRUG-01 rather than an independent check
recommendation: Replace with a sell-impact quote for the held amount (card ANTIRUG-03).

name: V3 signal 3: quote ratio floor
comparison: quotedOut (WETH base units) * 10000 / probeAmount (token base units) < 5000 trips; a QuoterV2 revert also trips
units: mixed: WETH per token in base units (a price, not a slippage)
rationale: detector.ts:1754-1757 comment (meant as > 50 % slippage)
overlap: always tripped for tokens worth less than 0.5 WETH each (AUD-ANTIRUG-006)
recommendation: Compare like units (card ANTIRUG-03).

name: V3 Burn-without-Collect grace window
comparison: the held Burn is evaluated at the first block >= burnBlock + 5 unless a Collect arrives first
rationale: detector.ts:203-212 (planner discretion; may move to config)
overlap: the pending entry is keyed by pool, not position (AUD-ANTIRUG-012)
recommendation: State it in time per chain and key it per position (AUD-ANTIRUG-012).

name: WebSocket heartbeat interval
current_value: 30000 ms; a missed pong terminates on the next tick (up to about 60 s to detect a dead socket)
comparison: isAlive false at a tick terminates the socket; otherwise ping and broadcast connected
rationale: detector.ts:105 (ANTIRUG-12, ws README)
overlap: detects a dead socket, not a missing subscription (AUD-ANTIRUG-008)
recommendation: Also require a recent log or block on the subscription for health (AUD-ANTIRUG-008).

name: Anti-rug WebSocket reconnect backoff
current_value: 1000 ms doubling to a 60000 ms cap
comparison: sleep, then rebuild; the loop ends after a provider is constructed
rationale: detector.ts:109-111 (matches bot.ts precedent)
overlap: same shape as the DEX loops (TH-BUY-11); a failed connect crashes before the second attempt (AUD-ANTIRUG-002)
recommendation: Single owner with an error listener and a shutdown check (OD-11).

name: Disconnect alert threshold and reconnect-failure alert count
comparison: disconnected duration > 60 s, once per window; consecutiveFailures >= 3, once per window
rationale: detector.ts:114-126 (D-VIS-WS-HEALTH)
overlap: effectively unreachable: construction never throws and a failed connect crashes first (AUD-ANTIRUG-002, -008)
recommendation: Make the alerts reachable with the OD-11 reconnect rework (AUD-ANTIRUG-008).

name: Anti-rug HTTP polling interval (no WS URL)
comparison: setInterval(async) every 2 s; one new interval per arm
rationale: detector.ts:128-132 (matches the bot.ts poller)
overlap: stacked pollers and no in-flight guard (AUD-ANTIRUG-007); TH-BUY-10 is the factory poller
recommendation: One guarded poller per chain (AUD-ANTIRUG-007).

name: Anti-rug exit wall-clock budget
comparison: withTimeout(executeFullSell, budget): overrun frees the caller, counts as a failed exit and alerts; the sell keeps running
effective_non_numeric: 60000 for "abc"; but a numeric prefix is accepted: "60s" gives 60 ms, "1e5" gives 1 ms
rationale: exitTrigger.ts:67-76: must exceed one 45 s confirm window plus margin
overlap: same env and default as TH-EXIT-21 and TH-BUY-14 (worker watchdog); can be exceeded while waiting behind the nonce lock (AUD-EXIT-014)
recommendation: Parse strictly and fail loud (card ANTIRUG-07); size it from the anti-rug attempt budget and confirm window (card EXIT-11).

name: Default V3 fee tier for the anti-rug sell simulation
comparison: position.feeTier ?? baseline.v3FeeTier ?? 3000
units: hundredths of a basis point (Uniswap fee units)
rationale: none in code
overlap: a wrong tier quotes another pool or reverts, which trips signal 3 (fail-closed); TH-BUY-21 is the honeypot-probe default
recommendation: Fail the evaluation (verdict unknown with an alert) instead of guessing a fee tier.

name: Anti-rug private attempt budget and public-fallback slippage
env_key: MEV_SELL_ANTIRUG_SLIPPAGE_PCT (slippage); the attempt budget is hard-coded
current_value: 1 private attempt; fallback slippage max(15, 10, routine slippage) %
comparison: reason anti-rug gets 1 private attempt before the public fallback; the fallback minOut uses the widened slippage
representation: integer constant; parseFloat with a > 0 check
rationale: exitEngine.ts:447-466 (a rug is happening now; a sandwiched sell beats a stranded position)
overlap: EXIT rows TH-EXIT-12 and TH-EXIT-14 own these numbers; listed here so the anti-rug emergency sell parameters are complete in one place
recommendation: Covered by the EXIT inventory (card OD-14 decides the private-sell floor).
